facts.F1: Story 6672: Azure DevOps OAuth: ask for write rights only when write-back is set up. The Azure DevOps OAuth connection always asks for vso.work_write, also when the connection is only used to read; a security review sees a read-only connection that holds a token with write rights. Ask only for read rights (vso.work) by default; ask for write rights (vso.work_write) only when write-back (Data Sync Mappings) is set up on that connection; the admin then signs in again to give the extra consent. AC: a new ADO OAuth connection without write-back asks only for read rights on work items; setting up write-back asks the admin to give write consent, and write-back works after that; a connection without write consent never tries to write; existing connections keep working.
